form201.incidentName: FICTIONAL EXERCISE - Maple Ridge missing adult with dementia
form201.situationSummary: FICTIONAL ILLUSTRATION ONLY; not an operational plan. Ellis Linden, fictional 74-year-old adult with dementia, wandered from a residence beside the pavilion and trail junction; last seen at that residence at 0600. Wearing a blue shirt and tan trousers; may not respond to calls. No verified clues at 0800. Summer forecast 27-31 C, humid; shaded woodland, uneven trails and ticks. No aircraft. Koster hub/spokes/rim: protect the residence/last-known-point hub, stage at the adjacent pavilion; search travel spokes promptly; observe likely rim exits, then search bounded areas and familiar attractors. All names, agencies, geography, contacts, capabilities and approvals are invented.

objectives: Mitigate all hazards to responders and the general public to an acceptable level, with particular attention to heat stress and tick exposure, throughout the entire duration of the incident. Brief all personnel before deployment, maintain buddy contact, perform tick checks at 1000, replenish ICP drinking water by 0900, conduct hourly hydration/electrolyte checks for all field teams, and require shaded rest plus heat-illness checks at 1300.
By 1000, document rapid route searches of spokes A (north footpath, 1.2 km), B (east lane, 1.0 km) and C (south creek trail, 0.8 km) from the hub to the rim; report tracks, clues and gaps to Ops.

By 0800, establish two paired observation posts at rim exits R1 north gate and R2 east footbridge; maintain observation through period end at 1900 with paired relief from returning spoke teams, report sightings immediately, and verify accountability and any continuing containment need with Ops.

By 1500, four canine teams will search and document coverage of bounded 15-hectare priority zones K1-K4 (60 hectares total coverage target) in the high-probability inner-ring (25% zone) around the residence/IPP, prioritizing downwind segments as wind is assessed on site; use short work/rest cycles, report actual GPS coverage and gaps, and reassess for heat, wind and canine welfare; coverage is a target, not an asserted POD or guaranteed completion.

By 1200, Spoke 1 will check and document all three familiar attractors within 1 km of the residence/IPP after its route search: fictional former bus stop, garden pond/shelter and creek crossing beside the old meeting hall, including hazard/water points observed from safe ground; use calm introductions and obtain permission before entering buildings.

form202.commandEmphasis: FICTIONAL EXERCISE ONLY. Life safety; protect the hub from scent contamination. All eight teams report directly to Ops; no branches, divisions or groups. 25 human field searchers INCLUDE four handlers; four dogs are equipment, not people. Seven IMT overhead; no aircraft. Stagger canine launches to preserve manageable active span.
form202.situationalAwareness: 0800 exercise snapshot. Subject may hide or not answer. Koster hub/spokes/rim guides prioritization, not a guarantee of containment. Do not presume an unsearched area cleared. Summer heat and ticks require continuous reassessment.

entries.mitigations: Use repellent per label, long trousers and buddy tick checks at 1000 and demob; promptly remove attached ticks with proper tool and report exposures to MEDL.
Maintain buddy contact, deliberate footing and suitable boots; avoid unstable banks and water entry. Stop and report unsafe crossings; use an alternate route authorized by Ops.

entries.hazardsRisks: Summer heat / dehydration / canine heat stress
entries.mitigations: ICP water resupply by 0900; hourly hydration/electrolyte checks for all field teams. Mandatory shaded rest and heat-illness checks at 1300, plus rest as needed; stage paired relief to preserve rim observation. Canine 20-minute work/cooling cycles; handlers monitor dogs continuously. Stop work for heat illness signs; notify MEDL, cool safely and request assistance.

form204.specialInstructions: FICTIONAL EXERCISE ONLY. Calm approach to vulnerable adult; do not chase. Preserve clues, report location immediately, avoid contaminating scent articles. openActionItems.item: First tick check: ALL teams complete and report buddy tick checks by 1000; Safety verifies completion; MEDL tracks exposures.
Hourly hydration/electrolyte checks for all field teams; replenish ICP drinking water by 0900 and arrange field/canine water delivery. Logistics and Safety verify every team.
MANDATORY shaded rest break and heat-illness check at 1300 for all field teams, supervised by Safety/MEDL; stage paired relief so rim observation continues.

End-shift demob: Safety begins tick/hydration checks at 1830 and verifies completion before release; account for all 32 people and four canines, complete task debriefs, equipment return and safe-travel checks. Maintain paired containment posts through 1900; verify continuing containment/relief needs with Ops before releasing anyone.
